section: How to Deposit: steps
text:
How to Deposit: steps
Valetax offers a range of instant, simple and secure funding methods catering to your requirements and preferences
1. Log in to your Member Area
2. Select your preferred payment channel Click on the Deposit button and select your preferred payment channel
3. Enter your account details and amount to deposit
4. Start Trading!

section: What is the minimum deposit amount?
text:
What is the minimum deposit amount?
The minimum deposit starts from 8 USD, depending on the account type.

section: How can I deposit funds into my account?
text:
How can I deposit funds into my account?
You may log in to your member area and select the preferred payment option and deposit size.

section: What currencies can I use to deposit funds?
text:
What currencies can I use to deposit funds?
You may deposit using any preferred currency into our USD account, which will follow that day’s exchange rates.

section: How long does it take for deposited funds to be credited to my balance?
text:
How long does it take for deposited funds to be credited to my balance?
Deposits are instant! You will be able to view your updated account balance within 60 minutes.

section: When will my funds be available for trading?
text:
When will my funds be available for trading?
You can begin trading immediately once your balance has been updated.

section: Where can I view my deposit and withdrawal history?
text:
Where can I view my deposit and withdrawal history?
You may log in to your member area to view all transactions related to deposits, withdrawals and transfers.

section: What is my withdrawal request status ‘pending’?
text:
What is my withdrawal request status ‘pending’?
This means your request in in queue and in the midst of getting processed. Once approved, you will be notified.

section: Why was my withdrawal request rejected?
text:
Why was my withdrawal request rejected?
It could be that your account has not been verified, a possible error to data entered or insifficient margin to process withdrawals. We will notify you via email on the rejection reason to help fix this issue.

section: I have not received my funds after my withdrawal request. What should I do?
text:
I have not received my funds after my withdrawal request. What should I do?
Should you not receive your funds within 24 hours, please reach out to our friendly support team for assistance.

section: How to Withdraw: steps
text:
How to Withdraw: steps
We’ve made fund withdrawals easy and instant, providing you with the ultimate convenience and assurance you deserve
1. Log in to your Member Area
2. Select your preferred payment channel
3. Enter your account details and amount to deposit
4. Start Trading!

section: How to Open an Account: steps
text:
How to Open an Account: steps
Discover a seamless trading experience with us. Open your account with us in 3 quick and simple steps
1. Visit www.valetax.com and click on ‘ Create Account ‘ at the top right of the page
2. Enter your details in the required fields and proceed to create your account
3. Upon successful registration, you will be provided access to your own Member Area
4. Once completed, you’re ready to make your first deposit . Visit How to Deposit for a quick guide to start trading with us!

section: How do I sign up for an account?
text:
How do I sign up for an account?
Click here follow the step-by-step instructions to verify and fund your account to start trading. Opening a live account allows you to begin trading immediately. We recommend clients to read through our Risk Disclosures, Privacy Policy and Terms of Business before they start trading.

section: What account type should I open?
text:
What account type should I open?
It will depend on your trading strategy and preferred trading instruments. You may view the various account types here . You may open another account type that suits you better at a later stage too.

section: What is the minimum initial deposit needed to open an account?
text:
What is the minimum initial deposit needed to open an account?
It will depend on the account type that is being selected. You may view details of all our accounts here and the minimum deposit that is required for each account type.

section: Do I need to provide any documents to open an account?
text:
Do I need to provide any documents to open an account?
For live accounts, we will require a Proof of identification and Proof of address via a bank statement or a utility bill that are not older than 6 months. Please ensure that your name is clearly displayed in these documents.

section: How long does it take to open an account?
text:
How long does it take to open an account?
Account opening and document verification will be completed within 48 hours.

section: What leverage settings should I select?
text:
What leverage settings should I select?
Your leverage setting is dependent on your trading strategy and goals. At Valetax, we offer up to 1:2000 depending on account types. For more details, visit our Account types page here for more details.

section: Do you offer an Islamic-friendly account?
text:
Do you offer an Islamic-friendly account?
All our account are Islamic friendly and there is no swap is credited or withdrawn from all trading account.

section: How to Verify Account: steps
text:
How to Verify Account: steps
Identity verification plays a crucial role in ensuring the utmost security and protection against identity theft and fraud
1. Complete the required fields and upload the required documents to complete your KYC profile
2. Once completed, you will be taken to this page while your account is being reviewed
3. Account verification completed ! You’re all set to trade
